text: Just 3 of the 16 live BAM nodes hold a majority of marketplace stake, with the largest at 23.2% and 93 validators concentrated on the busiest node in fra. BAM currently routes 32.0% of all Solana stake (141.9M SOL) across 374 validators. The top node by stake changed hands 70 times in this window — whale-driven routing, not structural rollovers.
